summary: Frontend-only Playwright test at 390x844 of the Eraser and the Sketch Gallery, plus a sketch regression. ERASER PASSED (basic cases): drew 2 strokes, then tapped sketch-eraser-button, which turned highlighted (rgb(224,122,95)). A vertical drag across the middle of stroke 1 split it, so the path count went 2 -> 3, and stroke 2's d attribute stayed identical. The grey ring (#9AA0A6, ring path) shows during the drag and disappears on release. Size changes the eraser: size 9 left a gap of about 90 units and size 18 a gap of about 149 units. Tapping sketch-ink-2F6FDE turns eraser mode off, and the next stroke is blue, width 18. Erasing alone marks the sketch as changed: back shows 'Leave without saving?', and Cancel stays. Saving keeps the erased result in localStorage (3 strokes), in the gallery thumbnail (3 paths) and after reloading /sketch/liver-s8?sketch=ID (3 paths). Over a picture (liver-s1 with x_liver_269), erasing removed only ink: the img stayed, no white strokes were added, and the screenshot shows the picture through the gap. GALLERY PASSED: home-open-sketches-button shows 'Your drawings…' when there are no sketches and '3 saved sketches across your chapters' with 3. Saved shows open-sketch-gallery-button 'My sketches (3)'. Both open /sketches. The empty state sketch-gallery-empty shows. Groups follow chapter order: I created the spleen sketch first, and the gallery still shows liver then spleen ('The Liver | 2', 'The Spleen | 1'). Items show the section title and date and draw the right number of strokes. Tapping an item opens 'Edit sketch'. Back with no change returns to /sketches without a prompt. Erase then save returns to /sketches with the thumbnail updated. sketch-gallery-open-topic-spleen opens /topic/spleen. REGRESSION PASSED: undo, clear (Cancel keeps the strokes), save, the section 'My sketches (1)' row and thumbnail, edit from the row, and delete with confirmation (the row is removed and the gallery goes back to empty). read-all-notes-button and section-speak-* are present. The resume card code is still present but I did not play audio this run. No page errors. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: every time the eraser touches a stroke, that stroke's path data roughly doubles in size. After 12 small eraser moves along one stroke, its d attribute grew from 831 to 5,730,318 characters, and each move took 66ms -> 321ms. This will freeze the app and go over the localStorage quota when saving. No deprecated packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: Reproduced: drew one stroke (d length 831), chose the eraser at size 4, then moved it 4px at a time along the stroke. After each move the stroke's d length was 3254, 6451, 12719, 25086, 49486, 97614, 192526, 379662, 748558, 1475598, 2908174 and 5730318. Each move took 66ms at first and 321ms by the end, and it keeps doubling. A normal lengthwise erase, or erasing near the same stroke many times, will freeze the UI. Saving a stroke of several MB to localStorage (about 5MB quota) will fail or lose data. Reference: app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:18-47 (strokePoints/eraseAt).

Undo only pops the last stroke in the array. It does not reverse an erase: after splitting a stroke, Undo deleted the right-hand piece of the erased stroke instead of restoring it (paths went 2 -> 1). Users will expect Undo to bring back what they erased. Reference: app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx:210

issues: Ink swatches are 32x32. hitSlop=6 brings the touch area to 44, so this is acceptable.
The size buttons (40x40) have no hitSlop, so they are slightly below the 44pt touch target.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the exponential growth of erased strokes in app/sketch/[sectionId].tsx. RCA: strokePoints() treats EVERY number pair in the smoothed path as a point, but toPath() writes one 'Q cx cy mx my' segment per input point (a control point plus a midpoint). So a path built from n points parses back into about 2n points. It is then filled in at step r/3 and written again with toPath, so its size doubles each time the eraser hits it, which happens on every move event. Recommended fix: store the raw points on the stroke (e.g. Stroke.pts: number[][], kept alongside d for drawing) and erase on those, never on the parsed d. Old strokes without pts can be parsed once, taking only the M point, each Q control point and the final L point. Also drop the filled-in points after splitting, or simplify (e.g. keep points >= 2 units apart), so pieces do not grow.

MEDIUM: Make Undo work with the eraser. Keep a history of stroke arrays: push the previous strokes before each stroke is added, and once at the start of each erase drag (onPanResponderGrant). Undo then restores the last snapshot.
LOW: Move setDirty(true) out of the setStrokes updater in erase() (a side effect inside a state updater runs twice in StrictMode). For example, compute the result in the handler using a strokes ref.
LOW: Add hitSlop to the size buttons (sketch-size-*) so they reach the 44pt touch target.
critical_code_review_comments: eraseAt runs on every pan move and re-parses and fills in every stroke with a regex (O(total points) per move). That is fine for a few strokes, but it gets slow on busy sketches even after the growth bug is fixed. Check the stroke bounds before parsing.
A 1-point leftover piece is dropped (filter pc.length > 1), so a tiny remaining tail vanishes. This is acceptable.
Gallery: thumbnails re-render the full SVG of every sketch. That is fine at current sizes, but with the growth bug above a single bloated sketch would also make /sketches slow.
Gallery code is clean: groups follow chapter order, items are newest first, the empty state is handled and the loaded flag hides the subtitle until storage loads.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (28/30 checks; 1 critical eraser growth bug, 1 medium undo-vs-erase issue)

seed_data_creation: None. All sketches were created in throwaway browser contexts (spleen-s1, liver-s1 and liver-s8), and the liver-s1 test sketch was deleted through the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce the growth bug: on /sketch/liver-s8, draw a horizontal stroke, choose the eraser at size 4, then mouse.down near the right end and mouse.move 4px left 12 times (steps=1), reading the d.length of the paths inside the visible sketch-canvas each time. A fixed version should stay around the original length or smaller. In localStorage, sono_study_sketches_v1 is double JSON-encoded. At 390x844 the canvas is 366x488 at (12,146). Use page.on('dialog') to handle confirm. Use :visible selectors, because the topic screen stays mounted under the sketch screen.
rca_of_issue: Eraser growth: toPath(pts) writes 'M p0 Q p1 mid(1,2) Q p2 mid(2,3) … L pn', which is about 2 number pairs per point. strokePoints(d) collects every pair as a point, so each erase hit doubles the point count, and filling in at r/3 adds more. toPath then writes it out again. Pieces next to the eraser get hit again on each move event, so their size grows exponentially within one drag. Fix: erase on the stored raw points, not on the parsed smoothed path.
